description: pixel art, the lower half of a lean young man master archer in elegant black leather armour with silver plates, black trousers and tall black boots, with a long dark green cloak and a long black bow strapped upright on his back, riding: seated astride a horse that is not drawn, seen strictly from the side and facing right; the hips sit on the saddle, the near thigh in black trousers lies forward along the horse's back, the near lower leg in a tall black boot hangs straight down from the knee, the boot rests level in a stirrup that is not drawn; the dark green cloak hangs down behind over the horse's back; only the near leg is seen; the same colours, outline, pixel size and shading as the upper half above, which stays as it is; nothing else: no horse, no saddle, no reins, no ground, transparent background
